description: A photograph depicting an expansive heathland or moorland landscape under an overcast sky. The scene is dominated by dense, low-growing dark green shrub vegetation covering the foreground and midground. Interspersed within the green shrubs are patches of lighter brown or yellowish bare earth and areas of darker, possibly rocky or moss-covered ground in the immediate foreground. In the far background, a line of vertical structures, which appear to be wind turbines or power line pylons, extends horizontally across the horizon. This image illustrates the type of heath and scrub formation or moorland vegetation described in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) documentation, characteristic of areas featuring species such as *Ulex* spp., *Calluna vulgaris*, *Vaccinium* spp., and *Erica* spp.
